>Adds a local Claude command and skill to automate migrating MCO test cases from openshift-tests-private to machine-config-operator. 
>
>**What it does:**
>
>  1. Collects source, destination, and migration target configuration
>  2. Analyzes source test files and destination patterns
>  3. Transforms and migrates test code (package, imports, naming, references)
>  4. Migrates helper functions and compat_otp utilities                                                                                                                  
>  5. Copies referenced template/testdata files                                                                                                                           
>  6. Builds the test binary and verifies migrated tests appear
>
>**Key Features:**
>
>- **migration of file** - Migrate a whole test file (e.g., `mco_configdrift.go`) 
>- **Accurate test name transformation** - Converts `Author:USERNAME-Qualifiers-ID-[Tags] Description` format to `[PolarionID:ID][OTP] Description` format
>- **Import rewriting** - Replaces all `compat_otp` references with `exutil` equivalents
>- **Build verification** - Compiles the binary and verifies migrated tests are listed
>
>**- What I did**
>
>- .claude/commands/migrate.md — a /migrate slash command that automates migrating MCO test cases from openshift-tests-private to machine-config-operator                                                                        
>- .claude/skills/mco-migration-workflow.md — the 4-phase workflow skill (input collection, analysis, migration execution, verification) that powers the command       
>
>**- How to verify it**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
>
>- Open Claude CLI in the machine-config-operator repo                                                                                                                                                                         
>- Run /migrate-tests - walk through the multiple phase migration workflow
>
>                                                                                                  
>
>**- Description for the changelog**
>
>-  Add local Claude /migrate command to automate MCO test migration from openshift-tests-private.
